meta.map1_caption: Measured: 103; too few searches: 97; no data: 30; China not measured. Among measured regions: rising 74, no significant trend 26, falling 3. Median growth 25.4% (IQR 9.6% to 43.0%). Small base: 6.

map1_legend.hatch_flat: Estimated growth shown; no statistically significant trend
map1_legend.no_data: No data (including mainland China: Google is not accessible there)
map1_legend.small_base: Small base: first-12-month average below 10 on Trends' 0–100 scale (growth ratio unstable)
map1_legend.clip_note: Values outside −50% … +150% are clipped for colour only.

caveats: Growth = average of the latest 12 months divided by the first 12 months of Nov 2021 - Oct 2026, minus 1, from Google Trends values; Trends is a sample; small bases inflate ratios; only the Latin-script term ASMR is measured
Mainland China is not measured: Google is not accessible there.
Colour scale uses growth_ratio_clipped in [-0.5, 1.5]; reported value is growth_ratio.
Measured geos require World Bank (or Taiwan official) population ≥ 1,000,000; smaller or unknown populations are treated as too few searches.
Small base: mean of the first 12 months < 10 on the Trends 0–100 index.
